name: video_reference_corridor_low_stairs_v1
description: Video-inspired straight indoor corridor with a synthetic low-clearance passage, an open switching buffer, and a small multi-riser stair proxy. The video shows the corridor and stairs; the low passage is added as a controlled training condition because no dog-hole is visible in the supplied footage.

information_contract.map: video-inspired authored corridor, synthetic low roof, and runtime stair support
information_contract.clearance: geometry-conditioned candidate features with live physical perception refresh
information_contract.floor: Isaac physical multi-riser stair support and calibrated flat floor
information_contract.objective: joint mode, route, time, path, energy, risk and switch cost
information_contract.scope: simulation curriculum and held-out evaluation; not a global optimality certificate
